working_definition: Neuropeptide re-clustering group named by the authors for AstA + Nplp1 co-expression; typed as an AstA-expressing neuron class.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron capable of peptide hormone secretion that expresses AstA.

justification: Name is defined by AstA expression, so the allatostatin A neuron class is the term for what the authors name; Nplp1 has no separate FBbt class. Pm3 not used because typing follows the authors name, not the origin of the cells.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Proximal medullary amacrine neuron that branches at the proximal surface of the medulla, with both branches forming a broad terminal arbor in medulla layer M9; GABAergic; ~35-40 cells per hemisphere (Davis et al., 2020; Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Typing follows the authors AstA+Nplp1 name, not parent cluster identity

recommendation: Accept exact match to allatostatin A neuron.
